application_review: PROGRESS. The previous audit was rechecked and all baseline proof hashes preserved.

The cyclic-order transport lemma proves equality of the actual weighted subgroup Gowers values for equal natural orders, with identical integer-coordinate test values and weights. Dependent finite-type instances are transported by equality elimination.
Positivity of R/M holds at every master stage, derived from original positive gap and modulus divisibility, without selecting a tuple.
The new full-window theorem fixes ZMod(R/M), aligned cells and original harmonic cell weights before quantifying same-pool tuples. It therefore does not silently use a tuple-dependent ambient group.
The exact factorization R/M=(P/M)*(R/P) transports the previous theorem with no additional error or hypothesis. Original shift P, interval, weights, bounded tests and uniform threshold are preserved.

Three new theorems are individually audited. The Bessel input, inverse theorem and full target remain unproved; connecting the common cell probability normalization to the subgroup-combination theorem is still required.
